explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/480: Chung and Graham proved inf_n liminf_m n|x_{m+n} - x_m| ≤ 1/c with c = 1 + Σ_{k≥1} 1/F_{2k}, and that this constant is best possible. The statement asserts that for every ε > 0, the bound 1/c - ε fails for some sequence in [0,1], which is the best-possible claim. The liminfs are of sequences bounded in [0, n], so they are well-defined. Faithful.
